newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville offers no weekend power, Mon at 300 MW.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville offers no weekend power, Mon at 300 MW.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered no surplus power for Saturday or Sunday and limited Monday sales to 300 megawatts (MW) during peak demand hours, the agency said Friday.
BPA also raised prices for Monday firm and non-firm offers during peak hours by $2.00 per megawatt hour (MWh).
No power was offered during off-peak hours on Monday.
On Thursday, BPA withdrew from offering spot next-day offers, citing a balance between long-term commitments and power generation.
Firm power delivered Monday to the Northwest during heavy-load blocks was offered at $20.00 per MWh and at $21.50 at the California-Oregon border (COB).
Non-firm power between 0700 and 2200 PDT Monday was offered at $20.50 in the Northwest and $22.00 at COB.
